summary: CAIR Action endorsed Virginia Cheung in the general election for San Francisco Board of Education, a recommendation the organization develops by considering civil rights and foreign policy, including Gaza and ceasefire positions. Her campaign platform addresses San Francisco education priorities—absenteeism, educator recruitment, equity, and budget transparency.
